texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]的近距离轨道上发现不明舰体的碎片。
texts.en: There are fragments of an unknown vessel in close orbit of [From.GetName].

sections.zh: 在[From.GetName]的近距离轨道上发现不明舰体的碎片。
sections.en: There are fragments of an unknown vessel in close orbit of [From.GetName].

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员在[From.GetName]近距轨道发现的放射性碎片的确是一艘太空舰船的残骸。其奇特的设计和我们数据库中的任何舰船型号都不同。

我们从其损坏的电脑上回收了一些数据，其语言前所未见——因此也无从翻译。

通过对残骸进行进一步研究，科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]推测这艘名叫“科塔罗号”的舰船遭遇了导航系统故障，脱离超光速推进的位置过于接近[From.GetName]的伽马射线流。大部分船体都已被辐射撕碎，上面没有找到任何生还者。
texts.en:
The irradiated fragments the [Root.GetName] crew registered in close orbit of [From.GetName] are indeed the remains of a space-faring vessel. With a very distinctive design, it matches no known make on record.

We have extracted some data from the ship's damaged computers, recorded in an alien language like nothing we have ever seen before - and one we are unable to translate.

By studying the remains, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] postulates that the craft, known as the 'Kohtalo', suffered a navigational error when exiting FTL, bringing it too close to the gamma-ray jets of [From.GetName]. Large portions of the ship were stripped apart through radiolysis. There are no survivors.

texts.zh: 探测器发现一艘舰船刚刚脱离超空间进入[kohtalo_second_fleet.GetStarName]星系，其特征与之前在[ouroboros_system.GetName]发现的独特残骸十分相似。他们正在呼叫我们！
texts.en: Sensors report a ship with seemingly identical properties to the unique remains uncovered near [ouroboros_system.GetName] has just dropped from hyperspace in the [kohtalo_second_fleet.GetStarName] system. They are hailing us!

texts.zh:
这艘舰船特征与先前在[ouroboros_system.GetName]星系发现的残骸十分相近，尽管翻译器无法解码其语言，他们看起来很高兴和我们通话。他们用一组低频语音信号指称自己，听上去与“科塔罗”相似——这名字我们已经有所耳闻。

我们也许可以使用原始数据和他们进行交流。
texts.en:
The crew of the strange ship that mirrors the wreck found near [ouroboros_system.GetName] seem excited to speak with us, though our translators cannot decode their language. They identify themselves with a low-frequency verbal expression that sounds like 'Kohtalo' - a name we've heard before.

Perhaps we can communicate using raw data.

label.zh: 试着询问他们来此地的目的。
label.en: Try to ask what their purpose here is.

texts.zh:
我们收到了一串数据作为回应，包括一张近星系的地图，以及一段录像，毫无疑问是他们的工程师在维护一台外星超光速设备。

唯一可以确定的是，他们是来自另一个星系的探索者。他们的无武备舰船可以佐证这一点。

我们发回了一段[Root.GetAdj]探险家第一次离开我们恒星系的录像，这些外星探索者看起来非常高兴。
texts.en:
We receive a flurry of data in response - including cartographic imaging of a neighboring galaxy, and footage of what can only be engineers working on an alien FTL drive.

We can draw no other conclusion than that these are explorers from another galaxy. Their ship's lack of weapons capacity would support this theory.

We send back footage of [Root.GetAdj] explorers on their first journey beyond our solar system, and the reaction from the alien crew appears to be jubilant.

label.zh: 将[ouroboros_system.GetName]附近的舰体残骸中回收的数据发给他们。
label.en: Send them data recovered from the [ouroboros_system.GetName] wreck.

texts.zh:
科塔罗号船员的热情瞬间消失了，许多船员开始用他们触手般的肢体操纵控制台。他们传送来一组数据，看起来是乘客名单，导航信息，船员日志。毫无疑问，这些数据和我们在[ouroboros_system.GetName]星系的发现完全吻合——除了一处例外。[ouroboros_system.GetName]残骸中的数据包含更多条目，日期也更加晚近。

看起来眼前的舰船和[ouroboros_system.GetName]里的残骸是同一艘船，只是残骸的历史更长。
texts.en:
The excitement of the Kohtalo crew seems to evaporate. Multiple crewmembers begin to tap away at consoles using their tentacle-like appendages. They transmit what look to be their passenger manifest, navigational data, and crew logs to us. Without a doubt, the data matches that of the [ouroboros_system.GetName] wreck to the letter - with one exception. The [ouroboros_system.GetName] wreck contained further entries, with later dates.

It would appear the [ouroboros_system.GetName] wreck is the same ship as the one now before us... only older.

texts.zh: 虽然他们依然维持着自己的外星礼仪，科塔罗号船员们的紧张不言而喻。我们的科学家称如果[ouroboros_system.GetName]星系中的残骸的确是这艘船未来的命运，透露给他们任何信息都可能会导致不可预见的结果。
texts.en: Despite their alien mannerisms, the Kohtalo crew's consternation is evident. Our own scientific attachés inform us that if the [ouroboros_system.GetName] wreck is indeed the future of the ship before us, any information we give them may have unforeseen consequences.

label.zh: 如果我们警告他们，他们应该就能逃过一劫。
label.en: If we warn them, they may avoid disaster.

tooltips.zh: 让科塔罗号注意避让[ouroboros_system.GetName]星系的脉冲星。
tooltips.en: Send the Kohtalo a warning to avoid the [ouroboros_system.GetName] pulsar.

label.zh: 我们不能冒险进一步干扰时间线。
label.en: We can't risk further timeline interference.

texts.zh:
这些系外旅行者焦虑地研究着我们传送过去的星系信息，用他们独特的语言互相交谈着，并在控制台上输入了一连串的指令。我们的外交人员耐心的等待着答复，但在收到回音之前，他们的引擎突然启动。

在我们能作出任何反应之前，他们就消失的无影无踪。
texts.en:
The extragalactic explorers begin poring hurriedly over the system data we send them, speaking to one another in their strange language, and entering a flurry of commands on their consoles. Our diplomats wait patiently for a reply, but before it can come, the ship's engines begin to power up unexpectedly.

Before we can react, they've vanished.

label.zh: 祝你们好运，星际旅行者。

texts.zh:
恒星系传感器显示，那艘异次元探索舰船科塔罗号突然在[ouroboros_system.GetName]星系外围脱离超光速状态，并迎头撞上了一颗环绕星系的彗星！这次灾难性的碰撞夺取了船上所有人的生命，并让船只的残骸飘向[ouroboros_system.GetName]的脉冲星。

看起来是这颗彗星，而不是脉冲星导致了科塔罗号的陨落。我们警告他们的行为反而导致这场悲剧的发生。现在有两具残骸静静地萦绕于[ouroboros_system.GetName]的脉冲星旁了。
texts.en:
System sensors indicate that the extradimensional exploration vessel Kohtalo exited FTL abruptly on the outskirts of the [ouroboros_system.GetName] system, colliding head-on with an orbital comet! The collision was disastrous enough to kill everyone onboard, and has sent the remaining wreckage spiraling in towards the [ouroboros_system.GetName] pulsar.

It would appear the comet, not the pulsar was responsible for the Kohtalo's demise, and in our effort to warn them of their fate, we seem to have caused it. Both wrecks now haunt the [ouroboros_system.GetName] pulsar.

note.zh: 科塔罗号撞上彗星，因果闭环。
note.en: The Kohtalo hits a comet; the loop closes.

texts.zh:
星系传感器显示，那艘异次元探索舰船科塔罗号突然在恒星系外围脱离FTL状态，并迎头撞上了一颗环绕星系的彗星！这次灾难性的碰撞夺取了船上所有人的生命，并让船只的残骸飘向[ouroboros_system.GetName]的脉冲星。

研究人员得出结论，科塔罗号配备的负质量效应超光速引擎无法精确的分析舰船何时何地脱离超光速状态。现在有两具残骸静静地萦绕于[ouroboros_system.GetName]的脉冲星旁了。
texts.en:
System sensors indicate that the extradimensional exploration vessel Kohtalo exited FTL abruptly on the outskirts of the system, colliding head-on with an orbital comet! The collision was disastrous enough to kill everyone onboard, and has sent the remaining wreckage spiraling in towards the [ouroboros_system.GetName] pulsar.

Our analysts conclude the Kohtalo's negative mass-based FTL drive was incapable of accurately predicting where (or when) they would exit subspace. Both wrecks now haunt the [ouroboros_system.GetName] pulsar.

label.zh: 也许这一切都无可避免。

note.zh: 未警告，飞船仍撞上彗星。
note.en: Not warned, the ship still hits the comet.

summary.text:
# 舰船碎片 / Ship Fragments

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:175-203; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:2409 (distar.60); events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:2454-2716 (distar.61-67); events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:2762 (distar.68)

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。调查中子星或脉冲星时可能生成（1级，权重1，全局一次）；若玩家物种使用 mol4 头像（科塔罗人外形）则不会生成。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn when surveying a neutron star or pulsar (level 1, weight 1, once per game); not if the empire's species uses portrait mol4 (the Kohtalo look).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. distar.60“炫目的命运”：残骸属于一艘名为“科塔罗”的外形独特的飞船，它脱离超光速时离脉冲星伽马射线流太近而毁灭，无人生还。
2. 360天后 distar.61“似曾相识”：一艘与残骸一模一样的船出现并呼叫我们 → distar.62–64：语言不通，改用数据交流；他们是来自另一星系的探险者，而对照数据后发现残骸就是这艘船——只是更“老”。
3. distar.65：警告他们 → distar.66 他们匆忙离去，360天后 distar.67“衔尾之蛇”：他们在星系外缘撞上彗星而毁灭——我们的警告恰恰导致了灾难；或不再干扰时间线 → 360天后 distar.68：同样撞上彗星，其负质量引擎无法准确预测出跃点。两种结局中两具残骸都留在脉冲星旁。

1. distar.60 "Blinding Fate": the wreck is a uniquely designed ship, the "Kohtalo", destroyed when it dropped out of FTL too close to the pulsar's gamma-ray jets; no survivors.
2. 360 days later distar.61 "Déjà Vu": an identical ship appears and hails us → distar.62–64: talking through raw data, they are explorers from another galaxy, and the data shows the wreck is this very ship — only older.
3. distar.65: warn them → distar.66, they leave in a hurry, and 360 days later distar.67 "Ouroboros": they hit a comet at the system's edge — our warning caused the disaster; or avoid further interference → distar.68 360 days later: the same collision, blamed on their negative-mass drive. Either way two wrecks now circle the pulsar.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

distar.65 的两个选项通向互斥的两种结局 67 / 68。

distar.65's two options lead to the exclusive endings 67 / 68.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无文明差异选项。

No empire-specific options.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常与 distar.60–68。树结构与延时正确；补充两种结局与互斥说明。30天后的通用接触报告 story.5 是共享事件，不属于本故事。

Checked the anomaly and distar.60–68. Tree and delays are correct; added the two endings. The generic contact report story.5 30 days later is a shared helper, not part of this story.
